new_claims.adaptive_compiler: complete auxiliary-law KL and dyadic instrument proof for rational SO(3) lists, rational unit seeds and positive affine probes
new_claims.causal_classification: complete written proof for repeatable nondisturbing probes, uniform whole-transcript TV, arbitrary adaptive policies and horizon-specific instruments
new_claims.causal_minimum: finite future-response cardinality is eventual minimum only for epsilon < 1/2
new_claims.causal_occupation: all-profile positive-cut bounds for infinite response quotient at every epsilon < 1, and below finite minimum for epsilon < 1/2
new_claims.generic_cli: supplied exact rational geometry and probe input with validation; terminal defaults preserved
new_claims.process_lower: explicit rational testing lower bound without spectral gap; not a sharp exponent

proof_vs_tests: Universal assertions have written proofs. Exact finite regressions exercise rows, variances and transcript laws but do not prove these universal statements. Final-head CI establishes source and artifact identity, not mathematical independence.
